[https://taylor.house.gov/issues/border]
Border | Representative Dave Taylor Skip to main content Border A strong Nation needs a secure border. I will work with President Trump and House Republicans to equip law enforcement and border officials with the tools, technology, and support they need to do their jobs safely and effectively to keep Americans out of harm's way. Under the Biden-Harris Administration, fentanyl poured over our borders, entering our neighborhoods in Ohio and making every state a border state. In 2021, over 5,000 Ohioans and over 70,000 Americans died from fentanyl and related substances. This is unacceptable, which is why I supported the HALT Fentanyl Act to keep not only fentanyl but also fentanyl-related substances off our streets. Cracking down on illegal aliens and smugglers entering our Nation is the first step toward ensuring our communities are safe from illicit drugs. I am proud to support legislation like the Laken Riley Act, the Preventing Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act, and the Agent Raul Gonzalez Officer Safety Act to defend Americans against violence and drugs brought into our country by illegal aliens. Prioritizing secure borders additionally protects our Nation against bad actors coming from America's foreign adversaries. By not holding those accountable who illegally enter our Nation, Congress risks not only the safety of Americans but our national security itself. Economy | Representative Dave Taylor Skip to main content Economy It's undeniable: families are paying far more to put food on their tables than they were a few short years ago. Due to inflation that soared under the Biden-Harris administration, hard-working families in Southern Ohio are pinching pennies in an economy that already challenges how far their dollars go. Congress needs to reign in wasteful government spending and allocate taxpayer dollars responsibly. I look forward to supporting legislation in Congress that prioritizes the American worker, their family, and their pocketbook. American families work hard every day and they need Congress to do the same: to balance a budget, reign in our soaring national debt, and spend taxpayer dollars effectively. This is key to ensuring a future for our country that is secure, prosperous, and puts America first. To bring back a booming economy, Congress needs to cut taxes for hardworking American families and combat inflation. Congress also must prioritize the creation of well-paying American jobs by bringing back American industry to our own soil. This will strengthen our economy and decrease our Nation's reliance on adversaries like China. Congress needs to unleash American energy to further invigorate our economy by utilizing an all of the above approach, including fossil fuel production and investing in nuclear energy. This will not only invigorate our economy but help combat the rising costs that have come with inflation. For more information concerning work and views related to the economy, please contact our office. Transportation and Infrastructure | Representative Dave Taylor Skip to main content Transportation and Infrastructure Safe and accessible roads, railways, aviation systems, and waterways are essential for transporting people and goods across our Nation. Especially in rural areas like Southern Ohio, having adequate funding to maintain and develop safe transportation systems and infrastructure enables families to stay connected with the rest of the Nation and the larger economy. I am committed to advocating for taxpayer dollars to be returned to Ohio's Second Congressional District for use on local projects to develop, maintain, and expand our transportation systems. I look forward to working with my colleagues on the House Transportation and Infrastructure Committee and President Trump to pass common-sense policies in the upcoming Surface Transportation Reauthorization and the Water Resources Development Act to fix our nation's crumbling infrastructure, eliminate burdensome federal regulations that prevent infrastructure growth, and to ensure our rural communities receive the funding and support they need to grow and succeed. More on Transportation and Infrastructure Image Congressman Taylor, Figures Introduce REVOKE Act to Crack Down on Chameleon Carriers September 4, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, DC –   Congressman Dave Taylor (OH-02) and Congressman Shomari Figures (AL-02) introduced the Registration Enforcement for Vehicle Operations of Known Evaders (REVOKE) Act, which will strengthen Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) and U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) authority to prevent chameleon carriers from exploiting USDOT registration systems to illegally operate on American roads.
